summary: Sidereal Confluence is a real-time trading frenzy where players desperately barter goods and technology across simultaneous negotiation rounds because no single race's economy can function alone. The chaos of everyone talking and dealing at once gives it a uniquely frantic, cooperative-feeling energy despite being fully competitive underneath.
praised: exhilarating real-time trading phase unlike almost any other game
creates a genuinely social, table-wide experience
criticised: can be overwhelming or exclusionary for shy or slower players
hidden scoring can feel opaque until the end
needs a full table (4-9) to shine
chaotic trading can leave some players confused about optimal plays

interaction.kind: real-time simultaneous negotiation and trading between all players every round
interaction.detail: Each round's economy is driven by a real-time free-for-all where players must trade resources and goods directly with each other to fuel their factions — no faction can function in isolation. Almost the entire game state (who has what to trade, who needs what) is visible and contested between players simultaneously.
interaction.said: Sidereal Confluence is known almost entirely for its interaction: players call the trading phase 'controlled chaos', note that 'you cannot succeed without trading with everyone else', and describe it as feeling cooperative in the moment despite being zero-sum in the end.

subsystems: technology invention (VP awarded per new tech, scaled by the round's Sharing Bonus)
race-specific VP-producing converters (production recipes that output points directly)
sources: Victory points converted from resources via economy/tech production each round
scoring.how_you_win: Over six fixed rounds of simultaneous trading and production, players quietly bank victory points from inventing technologies and running VP converters; after the final round, leftover resources are converted to extra points and whoever has the most total VP wins, with no tiebreaker.
scoring.score_note: varies with player count and rounds played
